Error.NotYours: You can only trade for your own characters.
Error.MerchantBroke: The merchant cannot pay that much right now.
Error.NoGM: Trades need a connected game master.
Error.Timeout: The game master's client did not answer.

Shop.NoBuyer: You have no character to shop for.
Shop.NoGm: No game master is connected: you can look, but not trade.
Shop.NoMoney: This system has no money the merchant knows how to handle; the game master hands items out.
Shop.NothingWanted: The merchant wants none of your things.
Shop.VisitOnScene: Visit this merchant where he stands on a scene to see his goods.

Config.LevelHint: The best goods he can have. A scene's level (or the party's) picks below it.
Config.MarkupHint: On all his prices; negative is a discount.
Config.BuyDiscountHint: What he pays for your things, below their value.
Config.PurseHint: What he can pay out per restock. Empty: unlimited.
Config.OwnRulesHint: Only exceptions, one row each - they come before the world's rules. Everyone else pays the plain price. "*" is anyone.
Config.SourcesHint: Compendiums, item folders or items, one per line - drop folders and items here.
Config.FilterHint: Conditions on the candidates, e.g. price<=500. Keys: {keys}.
Config.TurnoverHint: Share of the stock replaced on a restock; sold items come back anyway.
Config.FixedHint: Always offered, whatever the level - quest items, specials. Price in {unit}; empty: the item's value.
Config.ExactHint: The price as it is: no markup, no rules.
Config.ReplenishHint: Comes back on a restock. Unchecked: once sold, gone.
Config.DropHint: Drop world items or item folders.

Rules.Title: Merchants: prices and levels
Rules.Hint: Price rules by race and profession, item levels.
Rules.Intro: One row per exception, e.g. dwarf merchants charge elves +50%. A buyer no rule names pays the plain price. "*" is any merchant or anyone; a merchant's own rules come first.
Rules.None: No rules: everyone pays the same.
Rules.BracketsHint: Level 1 first. An item set to a level of its own (flag) or with a system level keeps that.
Rules.SystemLevelsHint: Item levels by rarity; items without one go by price.

Market.Title: Market
Market.SceneLevelHint: The stock is chosen for this level (at most each merchant's own). Empty: the party's level.

Generic.Hint: A data path (e.g. system.price). This system has no merchants adapter yet.

Craft.Title: Craft
Craft.Hint: His own make: random stock that matches a row's filter (empty: all) comes out that much stronger and costs that much more - '+5 … +20 %, +10 %' for an alchemist better than the rest. Strength scales heal and damage dice; an item it would not change stays plain. Custom stock is never changed.
Craft.NoItems: Needs the module Dewarim: Item templates - without it, the stock stays plain.
